note: اینسایت ۷۳ (insight/insight-73 — تعویض روکش و مدیریت بافت نرم در حضور التهاب ناشی از فودایمپکشن). All nine tags REUSE existing canonical concepts; nothing was minted. #کنترل_خونریزی، #تعویض_روکش، #مدیریت_بافت_نرم، #کانتکت_پروگزیمال، #فینیش_لاین and #اورهنگ each came back rank-1 score=1.00, and «نخ ریترکشن» resolved to #نخ_زیرلثه through its existing alias «نخ رترکشن». The one correction recorded here: a first pass simulated «فود ایمپکشن» and, getting nothing above the 0.5 threshold, was about to mint #فود_ایمپکشن as a new concept — but #گیر_غذایی has covered exactly this since five earlier articles (episode-121-1, insight-7, episode-159, chairside-28, chairside-37), and the query missed it only because the two spellings share no word. That is a discoverability hole in the library, not a missing concept, so this batch fixes the hole instead: the transliterated forms a dentist actually types are added to #گیر_غذایی's aliases and the article carries the canonical #گیر_غذایی. Tagged what the article RESOLVES: #سالکوس and #ژل_هموستاتیک are deliberately absent — the sulcus assessment is carried by #نخ_زیرلثه + #مدیریت_بافت_نرم, and the gel is the means of #کنترل_خونریزی, not a separate argument.
